newsitem.title: THAILAND: Export value of Thai vehicles, parts up in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Export value of Thai vehicles, parts up in Jan.

text.p: The export value of Thai assembled vehicles and parts jumped 88 percent to 1.43 billion baht ($55 million) in January from 761.6 million in the same month last year, an industry association said on Wednesday.
The export value of cars and car parts in the month surged to 896 million baht from 237 million in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automotive Industry Association said in a statement.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle parts exports in January was up 2.2 percent to 535.4 million baht from 523.9 million baht in the same month in the previous year, it said.
The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand in January fell 3.57 percent to 39,113 units from 40,559 in the same month in 1995.
